resources.string: Just A Rather Very Intelligent System

JARVIS uses this access only when you ask it to read or act on the active screen. It can read visible labels, use on-device OCR when needed, type requested text, and press controls. It does not read screen content in the background. A direct read-screen request is spoken on-device. In AUTO or WHISPER mode, visible screen text used by a screen-agent task is sent to your configured AI provider; DEVICE and OFFLINE modes block those tasks. You can revoke access at any time in this screen.
